|translation='''Title:''' Tech Mo'r.

'''Card text:'''
Immediately after using Ommni Box, you may look at the top X cards of the shuffled deck. X = the number of other musicians at the same location. You may shuffle again instead of looking at X cards.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. He plays the Ommni Box in Figrin D'an's band. He loses ownership of the instrument to Figrin D'an by gambling.
